description: Two centimetre rulers graduated in millimetres, each with a bracketed segment laid along it: A to B measures 8 cm and C to D measures 5 cm. Modern edition: Latin endpoint letters and digits only; the measured lengths, the millimetre graduation and the numbered centimetres are preserved and no measurement result is written on the figure.

authoritativeText.text:
118.
1) 下图中线段$AB$有多长？线段$CD$呢？
2) 把这两条线段分别用毫米表示出来。

inventory.description: Upper ruler: a rectangular body graduated in millimetres with longer marks every half centimetre and longest marks at the numbered centimetres 0 to 9.
Segment AB bracketed above the upper ruler, running from the 1 cm mark to the 9 cm mark, so it measures 8 cm. The length is not printed on the figure.
Lower ruler: a shorter rectangular body graduated the same way, with numbered centimetres 1 to 7; its zero mark is not printed.
Segment CD bracketed above the lower ruler, running from the 2 cm mark to the 7 cm mark, so it measures 5 cm. The length is not printed on the figure.
Printed centimetre numerals: 0 to 9 on the upper ruler and 1 to 7 on the lower one.
